recovery_note: Review 007H visually confirmed two complete FBI EC boundaries inside the acquired May 2004 official FBI Vault parent bundle. Physical pages 1-5 form the 2004-05-18 EC whose synopsis identifies the Charles Sabah Toma interview; page 1 is a fresh FBI EC start and page 5 closes with leads, diamond terminators, and internal page number 5. Physical pages 6-13 form a separate 2004-05-17 EC concerning information attributed to sources about Mohdar Abdullah; page 6 is a fresh FBI EC start and page 13 closes with leads, diamond terminators, and internal page number 8. Commission notes 22 and 23 cite these records by date/content. Exact-signature searches across the current normalized FBI corpus found no second copy of either record, so no duplicate release is presently mapped; that is not proof that no duplicate exists elsewhere. The exact 2002-07-23 ROI and 2004-05-19 Abdullah-investigation EC remain unresolved.
